import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:restage/restage.dart';
import 'package:acme_design_system/widgets.dart';

part 'restage.generated/welcome.restage.g.dart';

@Screen(id: 'welcome', surface: Surface.general)
class Welcome extends StatelessWidget {
  const Welcome({super.key});

  static const done = SurfaceEvent<void>('done');

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(children: [
        const AcmeBadge(),
        acmeTitle('Welcome'),
        AcmeHelpers.action(surfaceEvent(done)),
        const AcmeMark(),
      ]);
}
